about_the_game: Lets explore some of the features in Whites This. MC Escher style 4D with some full 3D gravity effects. Go find the sacred sphere of gravity, Find the two beloved rabbits.
detailed_description: Lets explore some of the features in Whites This. MC Escher style 4D with some full 3D gravity effects. Go find the sacred sphere of gravity, Find the two beloved rabbits.
name: Whites This Demo

short_description: A 4D possibly 5D game where you explore a maze in MC Escher style. Gravity can change to swap your perspective of the area you are in. Use the gravity to bypass obstacle or to make your life harder.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Welsh
*languages with full audio support
